personas.name: Student
goals: See my clubs, events and attendance

assumptions: A club has one advisor, stored on the club record
Advisors and students sign in with the same email address stored on their club or student record
Students join clubs through a membership record created by an advisor or admin
New clubs start as pending approval until a school admin approves them
Email and in-app notifications only; no SMS or push
No fees or payments for clubs
No integration with the school's student information system
English only; times shown in school local time (IST)

params.subject: {name} has been approved
params.body: Hi {advisor_name}, your club {name} is now active. Students can join and you can schedule events.

requirements.text: Maintain a catalogue of clubs with category, advisor and weekly meeting slot, and an approval flow for new clubs
Keep a student roster and record which clubs each student belongs to, with a club role such as president or treasurer
Schedule club events (meetings, workshops, competitions) and show them on a calendar
Record attendance for each event per student (present, absent, late, excused)
Advisors manage only their own clubs' members, events and attendance; students see only active clubs and their own records
Email the advisor when a club is approved and remind members of events happening today
Show a dashboard of active clubs, clubs awaiting approval, today's and upcoming events, and clubs by category
